title: Projective modules
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $P$ an $R$-module. $P$ is *projective* if the functor $\operatorname{Hom}_R(P,-)$ from $R$-modules to $R$-modules is exact; equivalently (Stacks Lemma 05CF, which Mathlib proves as `Module.Projective.iff_split`) $P$ is a direct summand of a free $R$-module $F=\bigoplus_{i\in I}R$, i.e. there are $R$-linear maps $i:P\to F$ and $s:F\to P$ with $s\circ i=\mathrm{id}_P$; equivalently every $R$-linear map from $P$ lifts along every surjection of $R$-modules.
